title: 第11章 修仙家族的人灵石第12章 矿区地盘之争
content_zh:
第11章修仙家族的人，灵石
时间匆匆，在不知不觉流逝，玄岳宗所处的山脉树木枝繁叶茂，天气变得炎热起来，矿洞中林浩干完今日的活，抹了抹额头上的汗水。
与关系不错的小胖子王富，走出矿洞，他看着夕阳落日，不禁喃喃道：“不知不觉，已经在玄岳宗快接近五个月。”
“咦！
不好！
老大，我还有几天就不是新人杂役了。”
听到‘五个月’这三个字，小胖子王富脸色骤然间一变，按照宗门规定，新入门的杂役弟子只能在新人区停留半年。
他比林浩先来许多天，算起时间，三天后他就得被迫离开这里，前往陌生的杂役弟子老人区干更多的活。
这五个月有林浩这个老大照顾，王富日子过的非常舒服，让他离开新人区，比杀了他还难受。
“王富，这几个月你的修为达到炼气一重后期，去杂役弟子老人区那边，应该没事吧！”
林浩拍了拍他的肩膀道。
“老大，在老人区杂役弟子炼气一重后期修为，根本不够看，要修炼到炼气二重，才能不会被别人欺负。”
王富哭丧着脸，想到老人区传言的那些狠角色，他头皮发麻，才过五个月好日子，就又要过水深火热的日子。
“来，王富给你老大笑一个，千万别害怕，既然躲不过，就勇敢的去面对。”
林浩化身为鸡汤大师道：“只要熬上一些日子，等你修为达到炼气二重，成为老人区的高手，就能过好日子了，生活啊！
得向前看……。”
又过了几日。
小胖子王富走了，极其不情愿的去了杂役弟子老人区，离开的时候，哭得撕心裂肺。
林浩看着他的背影，有些伤感，在玄岳宗只有小胖子和他关系算得上是朋友，现在朋友离去后，就没有人和他吹牛聊天了。
翌日，在王富搬走后，空出来一个床位，一名新入门的杂役弟子，被安排在这里。

“林浩师兄，在下李飞龙今年十二岁，三品火木属性灵根，今日刚加入玄岳宗，久仰林浩师兄大名，还请林浩师兄多多关照。”
那新人杂役才搬进来，便恭敬的道。
林浩面色微微一愣，对方看着身高都快七尺有余，除了一张脸很稚嫩，跟成年人看起来没啥区别，没想到真实年纪这么小。
“你刚来这里，怎么就知道我姓名？”
他打量新来的杂役弟子一会，不由问道。
“林浩师兄，我来自赵国的一个修仙小家族，在玄岳宗有些熟人。”
李飞龙拱了拱手，解释道：“之所以知道师兄名字，是因为我通过向外门的左师兄打探，那位左师兄给我介绍了一些这里的情况。”
“原来如此。”
林浩心中微微一惊。
对方竟然来自修仙家族，在玄岳宗有熟人，可比他这种没根脚的人强多了。
“林浩师兄，在下有一事相求。”
李飞龙沉吟片刻道。
“何事？”
林浩想了想道。
“听说师兄你在第十队新人区，是最强的人，不仅其他杂役都服你，还挖矿特别快。”
李飞龙继续道：“我想请求师兄，每天帮我挖矿。”
“让我帮你挖矿？”

Chapter 11: People from the Immortal Cultivation Family, Spiritual Stones
Time flew by unknowingly. The mountains where Xuanyue Sect was located had lush trees and the weather became hot. In the mine, Lin Hao finished his work for the day and wiped the sweat from his forehead.
Wang Fu, a fat boy with whom he had a good relationship, walked out of the mine. He looked at the setting sun and couldn't help but murmured: "Unknowingly, it has been almost five months in Xuanyue Sect."
"Hey!
Not good!
Boss, I won't be a rookie handyman in a few days. "
Hearing the words 'five months', the face of the little fat boy Wang Fu suddenly changed. According to the sect's regulations, new handyman disciples can only stay in the newcomer area for half a year.
He came many days before Lin Hao. Counting the time, he would be forced to leave here in three days and go to the unfamiliar handyman disciple elderly area to do more work.
In the past five months, with Lin Hao as the boss taking care of him, Wang Fu had lived a very comfortable life. Letting him leave the newcomer area was even more uncomfortable than killing him.
"Wang Fu, your cultivation has reached the late stage of the first level of Qi Refining in the past few months. You should be fine if you go to the elderly area for handyman disciples!"
Lin Hao patted his shoulder and said.
"Boss, the late stage cultivation of the first level Qi refining of the handyman disciples in the elderly area is simply not good enough. You have to practice to the second level of Qi refining to avoid being bullied by others."
Wang Fu cried sadly, thinking of the ruthless characters rumored to be in the elderly area, his scalp was numb. He had only had five good months, and he was about to live in dire straits again.
"Come on, Wang Fu will give you a big laugh. Don't be afraid. Since you can't escape, face it bravely."
Lin Hao transformed into Chicken Soup Master and said: "As long as you survive for a few days, when you reach the second level of Qi Refining and become a master in the elderly area, you will be able to live a good life, life!
Gotta look forward…. "
A few more days passed.
The little fat boy Wang Fu left and went to the elderly area for handymen disciples with great reluctance. When he left, he cried heartbrokenly.
Lin Hao looked at his back and felt a little sad. In Xuanyue Sect, only the little fat man could be considered a friend with him. Now that his friend has left, there is no one to brag and chat with him.
The next day, after Wang Fu moved out, a bed became available, and a new handyman disciple was placed here.
"Senior Brother Lin Hao, I'm Li Feilong, who is twelve years old this year. He has a third-grade fire and wood spiritual root. He just joined the Xuanyue Sect today. I have admired Senior Brother Lin Hao for a long time. Please take good care of me, Senior Brother Lin Hao."
The new handyman had just moved in and said respectfully.
Lin Hao's face was slightly startled. The other person looked almost seven feet tall. Except for his childish face, he looked no different from an adult. He didn't expect that he was actually so young.
"You just came here, how come you know my name?"
He looked at the new handyman disciple for a while and couldn't help but ask.
"Senior Brother Lin Hao, I come from a small family of immortal cultivators in the Zhao Kingdom, and I have some acquaintances in the Xuanyue Sect."
Li Feilong cupped his hands and explained: "The reason why I know the name of Senior Brother is because I inquired about Senior Brother Zuo from the outer gate, and Senior Brother Zuo introduced me to some of the situation here."
"That's it."
Lin Hao was slightly shocked.
The other party actually came from a cultivating family and had acquaintances in the Xuanyue Sect, but he was much better than a baseless person like him.
"Senior Brother Lin Hao, I have a favor to ask of you."
Li Feilong pondered for a moment and said.
"What's the matter?"
Lin Hao thought for a while and said.
"I heard that you, senior brother, are the strongest person in the rookie section of Team 10. Not only do other handymen obey you, but you are also very fast at mining."
Li Feilong continued: "I want to ask my senior brother to help me mine every day."
"Want me to help you mine?"
